# Advocate Md. Shah Alam — Law Chambers, Bangladesh

> Official website of Advocate Md. Shah Alam, Supreme Court Advocate of Bangladesh. 10+ years experience in Criminal Law, Family Law, Land Law, Company Law and Tax Law. Chamber in Uttara, Dhaka.

## About

Advocate Md. Shah Alam is a practicing lawyer at the Supreme Court of Bangladesh. He is also Assistant Public Prosecutor at the Metro Sessions Court, Dhaka. He holds an LL.M from Dhaka International University and has over 10 years of active legal practice in Bangladesh.

- Name: Advocate Md. Shah Alam
- Title: Advocate, Supreme Court of Bangladesh
- Additional Designation: Assistant Public Prosecutor, Metro Sessions Court, Dhaka
- Location: Uttara, Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Phone: +8801712655546
- Email: contact@advmdshahalam.me
- Website: [advmdshahalam.me](https://www.advmdshahalam.me)

## Legal Services

- Criminal Law & Defence
- Bail Applications (All Courts + High Court)
- Divorce & Family Law (Muslim, Hindu, Christian)
- Land & Property Law
- Company & Corporate Law
- Tax & VAT Law
- Writ Petitions (Supreme Court)
- Cyber Crime Defence

## Practice Courts

- Supreme Court of Bangladesh (High Court Division & Appellate Division)
- Metro Sessions Court, Dhaka
- All District & Sessions Courts, Bangladesh
- Family Courts, Bangladesh
- Magistrate Courts, Bangladesh

## Education

- LL.M — Dhaka International University (2010)
- LL.B & Bar Council — Metro Police Ideal Law College, Dhaka (2008)
- LL.B — Gazipur Law College, Gazipur (2006)
- BBA, MBA — Asian University of Bangladesh (2004–2007)

## Additional Practice Areas

- NRB (Non-Resident Bangladeshi) Law: property, inheritance, power of attorney, dual citizenship / NVR matters — [NRB Legal Help](https://www.advmdshahalam.me/nrb-legal-help)
- Land Law: registration, mutation (namjari), partition suits, RS/CS khatian
- Family Law: divorce, dower, custody, Muslim inheritance (Faraid)
- Criminal & Cyber Law: anticipatory bail, High Court bail, cyber crime complaints
- Company & Tax Law: company registration, VAT, income tax
